iconicAnchor.label: Danish Modern furniture and domestic interiors of the 1940s through 1960s
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Nordic modern furniture designers and cabinetmaking tradition
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Designmuseum Danmark connects Danish Modern's defining furniture to beauty, comfort, minimalism, innovative methods, and a continuing tradition of good craftsmanship.

sources.title: Danish Modern
supports: Danish Modern developed through furniture design and cabinetmaking that joined comfort, minimalism, beauty, and craft innovation.
The tradition includes organic and elegant furniture as well as more experimental later forms, so Nordic modernism is not a single pale retail look.

sources.title: New Material, New Form
supports: Soft organic form and an emphasis on natural materials, especially wood, are characteristic signals of Scandinavian modernism.
Research into production techniques and bent wood helped modern furniture achieve its distinctive softened geometry.
